title: persea microcarpa
intro: Persea microcarpa, commonly known as Bagtikan or Canarium tree, is a plant species native to the Philippines. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Persea microcarpa include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive compounds found in Persea microcarpa have been shown to have potential therapeutic applications in the prevention and treatment of various diseases.
